description:
mvmPlayer brings movies, series, lessons and personal recordings to the mvmOS desktop and an Apps Hub browser page. Each profile keeps independent watching progress, favourites, history and collections.

Library folders
Choose a folder on this server or one shared from another mvmOS. Videos stay where they are; manual or scheduled scans find files, recognise movie years and episode numbers, and read SRT or WebVTT subtitles beside the videos. Shared videos play directly from the sharing server. Open a single file from File Manager without importing it.

Details and covers
Open a series to look up its details online, choosing among the seasons and episodes you actually have. Series information and the series cover are kept once and shown on every episode that has no picture of its own, and series you have already identified fill in new episodes by themselves. Movies have their own lookup button and are never filled in automatically, so a wrong match cannot slip in.

Subtitles
The player lists the subtitles stored inside MKV and WebM videos as soon as the film opens, including films on a folder shared from another mvmOS. Pick one and it is read by your browser straight from where the film is stored, with a progress indicator, so nothing passes through the mvmOS server. The player also selects a subtitle in your language and supports loading a subtitle file from your device. Playback uses the browser’s codecs without transcoding.

Simkl
With a Simkl client ID shared by the administrator through Apps Hub Service keys, each profile can connect its own Simkl account. Browse trending titles, viewing history and planned shows, inspect seasons, mark episodes or seasons watched, and report completed videos to that account.

Optional subtitle translation
Premium adds subtitle translation through your configured mvmAI. Choose any available subtitle, external or stored inside the video, and the target language; for a subtitle inside the video the browser reads its text first and sends only that text for translation. The administrator enables it, viewers review the credit quote, and completed translations become selectable subtitles. The ordinary video library and existing subtitles work without this option.
capabilities: Desktop and responsive Apps Hub interface with a shared video library.
Server and connected shared library folders, manual or scheduled scans, and playback without copying videos.
Uploads into a chosen library folder through the shared uploader.
Filename and folder recognition for movie years, series, seasons and episodes.
Independent watching progress, completion, favourites and personal collections.
Browser playback with seeking, speed, fullscreen, picture in picture and automatic next episode.
SRT and WebVTT sidecar detection, subtitles stored inside MKV and WebM videos, preferred-language selection and local subtitle files.
Online series and movie lookup with season and episode selection, a shared series cover for episodes, and automatic filling of already identified series.
Optional Simkl account connection, trending titles, personal history, planned shows and watched episode or season controls.
Open videos directly from File Manager in the existing player.
No transcoding, FFmpeg installation or separate media server required.
requirements: A browser that supports the video container and audio/video codecs.
Simkl features require an administrator-shared Simkl client ID; personal history and watched controls also require connecting your Simkl account.

integrations.name: mvmAI
integrations.summary: Translates subtitle text into a selected language while preserving its timings. This optional feature requires Premium and administrator activation.
integrations.requires: mvmAI installed and configured, with its App API enabled in Apps Hub → Settings → App APIs. The switch is off by default.
